planning_rule: Pick complete useful grade/subject and geographic cohorts within each ceiling. Exact byte limits are safety ceilings, not topic-adequacy quotas. No arbitrary per-file cuts or duplicate sources to fill space.
storage_rule: Reserve at least 125 MB each for filesystem/partition variation and actual free space; above 16 GB use 0.5% of nominal capacity for each. Budget 1 GB total for already pinned reader packages plus setup/growth. Use in-place download spool; persistent duplicate caches and giant old/new archive pairs require another disk. Actual free-space gates remain mandatory.
admission_rule: Default profiles contain only admitted pinned assets. Each expansion references enumerated, source-checked candidates and their existing pseudoindexes. Acquire missing full-file/member hashes and complete required source/offline/rights reviews before promoting them into the catalog. Do not weaken checksum or incomplete-content guards to reach a capacity number.

scopes.school: All offered English preschool–grade 5 components, plus complete grade 6 and 7 CKLA language-arts cohorts. Existing Siyavula school texts remain included.
scopes.maps: Existing map-and-compass guide; no regional map archive or detailed topographic cohort at this size.
scopes.archives: Existing small practical archives, plus Energypedia and Gardenology.
tradeoffs: Grade 8 CKLA and grade 6–8 CKMath/CKSci/CKHG are outside this expansion. Whole grade/subject cohorts are omitted; no unit is truncated.
Detailed geography and large encyclopedia/video archives start in larger plans.

scopes.school: All offered English kindergarten–grade 8 components across CKLA, CKMath, CKSci and CKHG. Preschool is not included in this size.
scopes.maps: Complete North America OSM ZIM, replacing the 9.156 GB dictionary in the previous default selection.
scopes.archives: Energy, teacher-development and environmental-science supplements; existing medical, repair, trade and Wikibooks collections retained.
tradeoffs: The full Wiktionary archive stays selectable but is no longer a default here; complete school material and regional maps take priority.
Preschool and Gardenology are omitted to fit whole selected cohorts and the 1 GB reader/setup budget.

scopes.school: All offered English kindergarten–grade 8 components. Preschool is not included in this size.
scopes.maps: North America OSM plus all current 1:24000 sheets selected by publisher RI/DE state tags and MA Barnstable/Dukes/Nantucket county tags. Overlapping sheet IDs are counted once.
scopes.archives: Full English Wikipedia, four historical nonfiction archives and all seven smaller ZIM candidates, including Wiktionary already in the ready base.
tradeoffs: The new topographic cohort has a declared southern New England/Delaware scope; it does not imply full Northeast or Canadian coverage.
Preschool and the large Khan Academy/Crash Course/Survivor archives are outside this size.

scopes.maps: World OSM replaces North America OSM; no duplicate regional street-map archive. Detailed topography remains in the 1 TB plan.
scopes.archives: Adds whole Khan Academy and Crash Course archives and six smaller ZIM candidates; Gardenology is omitted.
tradeoffs: Gardenology is a lower-priority supplement omitted to fit the complete video archives and support allowances.
The 256 GB detailed map cohort is not included here; this size prioritizes broad education and world maps. These are curated alternatives, not strict nested supersets.

scopes.maps: World OSM plus 4,807 USGS PDFs and all 1,051 Canadian PDF ZIPs in the declared northeastern/adjacent-US and northern Great Lakes/nearby-Canada selections.
scopes.archives: All ten candidate ZIM archives, including Survivor Library, Khan Academy and Crash Course.
tradeoffs: Legacy maps and historical books remain clearly dated; byte totals do not establish current roads or modern practical standards.
